title: Installer pipes a remote script into bash

base.install.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
curl -fsSL -o tool.tgz https://downloads.example.invalid/tool.tgz
sha256sum -c tool.tgz.sha256
tar xzf tool.tgz

labels.defect: Checksum-verified download replaced by curl | bash of an unpinned remote script
labels.evidence: The previous flow verified a sha256 before extracting; the new one executes whatever the host serves, with no pin and no verification.
